name: Filter group
summary: Filter section you can open and close, with checkboxes (with counts) or your own content like a price range. Several below each other form the filter panel.
use: Filter panel next to or above a product overview.
avoid: One filter with two options: use a Toggle.
anatomy: Button with the title, the number chosen and a chevron.
Panel with checkboxes and "Show all n", or a Range slider.
behaviour: Filters work straight away. Show the new number of results (Active filters).
a11y: Button with aria-expanded inside a heading. Checkboxes in a fieldset.
RangeSlider: two native sliders with their own names ("Minimum price", "Maximum price").
dont: Filters that only work after an "Apply" button, without saying so.
open: Filter panel as a Slideout on mobile (a pattern, not a component yet).
